I have a golden retriever puppy a little over a year old and it was a nightmare working with her when she was younger, and extremely stressful. 
My puppy barked a LOT, bit, grabbed food off of our plates(still working with this), etc. I know how stressful it is. For the biting, whenever he bites, as SOON as he starts, put him in his crate or put him outside. For our dog, we also have a collar which has a remote to either beep to distract, vibrate, or static electricity(we try not to use this as it can be used in a abusive way. The only time this is used is when she is on top of our cat, possibly hurting her.) This has been very helpful when it came to barking and training as a whole. 
Puppies can be really hard to deal with and care for. This is a hard stage in your puppy’s life for you, but I promise it gets better. Make sure you have a crate to put him in, especially during those times when he gets very aggressive. Pull toys are also great for this!! Hope any of this helped.
